topic: Darakaraka — the Jaimini partner significator most readings skip (DD deep-dive reel, English, 2026-08-31 pm)

slides.sub: Your chart names a partner significator. Most readings never look at it.

slides.body:
Jaimini is a second system of Jyotish, running alongside the more familiar Parashari one, with its own rules. Its signature tool is the chara karakas — "movable significators".

You take the degree each planet sits at, ignore the sign, and rank all seven from highest to lowest. Each rank is handed a role. The ranking is different for every chart — that is what makes it chara, movable.

Write down the degrees of the seven planets — Sun through Saturn, no Rahu or Ketu in the seven-karaka scheme. Strip the signs. The planet at the lowest degree is your Darakaraka.

Some schools use an eight-karaka scheme that includes Rahu, counted in reverse. Pick one and stay in it — mixing the two is where most confusion starts.

points: The nature a partner tends to carry — Saturn as DK reads very differently from Venus as DK
The lesson the partnership brings, not the person's identity
Its sign and house colour the setting a partnership forms in
Its nakshatra is the finer grain — read it before you read anything else
7th house and 7th lord first — the primary marriage axis in Parashari
Venus as the natural karaka for partnership
Navamsa (D9) — the ninth-part divisional chart; check where the DK lands there
Upapada Lagna — the Jaimini marriage arudha, a separate tool from the DK
Dasha — the planetary period system; without it there is no timing

slides.body:
The Darakaraka does not name a person, a date, or a caste, and it does not decide whether a marriage is good. Read at that level it stops being technique and becomes guesswork with a Sanskrit label on it.

It describes a tendency and a lesson. Four charts with Saturn as Darakaraka will read four different ways once house, sign, nakshatra and dasha are added.

Lowest degree among the seven. Takes two minutes.

Comment the planet you land on — and save this reel, the ranking list on slide 3 is the whole method.
